title: Installing Kitchen Sink Plumbing: Compression Fittings, Faucet, Drainage, and Dishwasher Connections
summary: This Old House guides a complete kitchen sink plumbing install focused on a two-bowl island sink. The video demonstrates assembling copper supply lines with compression fittings (nut and ferrule), installing a sensor-enabled faucet, and building a drainage system that includes tailpieces, a trap, venting, ABS drain piping, plumber’s putty, and dishwasher drainage connections. A test of the system follows water restoration, including evaluating the faucet’s touch control feature. The instruction emphasizes careful seating and alignment, avoidance of pipe dope on plastic connections, and the use of ABS glue for drain piping, culminating in a functional, leak-free installation with new shutoffs and dishwasher/discharge integration.

sections.title: Compression fittings: nut, ferrule, and pipe insertion
sections.description: Explains the nut-and-ferrule compression joint: slide the nut over the pipe, insert the ferrule, push the pipe fully into the fitting, then tighten to deform the ferrule for a watertight seal. A light coat of pipe dope may be applied.

sections.title: Faucet installation and sensor-spout overview
sections.description: Introduces mounting the faucet and its sensor-equipped spout; explains that the unit includes a solenoid and battery, allowing touch-activated on/off behavior. Demonstrates tightening the faucet nut and cautions against improper material use.

sections.title: Island sink drainage anatomy and initial prep
sections.description: Describes the drainage layout for a two-bowl island sink, including separate basket strainers, tailpieces, a branch for the dishwasher, a tee into the trap, and the vent. Begins prep by applying putty to the basket area.

sections.title: Drain assembly: cutting, gluing ABS, and alignment
sections.description: Shows aligning the tailpiece against the basket, measuring and cutting pipe lengths for the trap, and gluing ABS piping (noting ABS uses glue-only rather than a cleaner). Emphasizes getting angles right on the first try.

sections.title: Final connections, dishwasher, and test
concepts: hot/cold water lines to dishwasher and ice maker
sections.description: Completes the install with the final drain connections, dishwasher line hookup, clamp securing, and the new shutoffs. Reinstates water and tests the system, including the touch-feature faucet.
